title: Missing 411: national park disappearances tied to UFO sightings and hidden FBI files

plain: People who go missing in US national parks vanish in the same areas where people report seeing UFOs, according to a writer Jason Jorjani calls David Pitus, the author of the Missing 411 books on unexplained disappearances in the parks. Jorjani, a researcher, repeats this to Michels as what Pitus found, and links it to a work called Closer Encounters and to FBI files on the cases that the story says are kept hidden. If true, it would tie some of the disappearances to the UFO phenomenon.
